events.title: AAOI Stock Before Q1 Earnings: Smart Buy or Risky Move?
events.body: Applied Optoelectronics reports Q1 2026 earnings on May 7, guiding $150M-$165M revenues as CATV and data center demand stay strong.

events.title: Why Ciena (CIEN) is Poised to Beat Earnings Estimates Again
events.body: Ciena (CIEN) has an impressive earnings surprise history and currently possesses the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely beat in its next quarterly report.

events.title: Lumentum Q3 Earnings Loom: Buy or Sell the Stock Ahead of Results?
events.body: LITE's fiscal Q3 outlook is likely to have pointed to surging AI-driven demand and strong revenue growth, but premium valuation raises the key question for investors.
